name: Fira
doc: Fira (the spell): the root and one director an action on its target - the fireball projectile and its trail, the flame column, the shock ring, the burst, sparks and embers, the screen flash, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag142_fira.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: One director an action on its target: the fireball projectile and its trail, the flame column, the shock ring, the burst, sparks and embers, the screen flash, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of an action's director

params.label: Ember
params.doc: The sprite sequence ember (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Shock ring
params.doc: The sprite sequence shock ring (a flipbook of 1 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Flame column model
params.doc: The prim model flame column (a mesh of 54 vertices, 36 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Burst model
params.doc: The prim model burst (a mesh of 72 vertices, 54 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Trail model
params.doc: The prim model trail (a mesh of 26 vertices, 40 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
